test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

I heard management is planning to transfer me to another department and demote me. I need to confirm if this is true by hearing it __directly from the person involved__ and from my manager.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'straight from the horse's mouth'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"straight from the horse's mouth"** means obtaining information directly from the source or person who has direct knowledge. (स्रोत से सीधे जानकारी प्राप्त करना) • **Example:** To make sure the news was true, she decided to get it straight from the horse's mouth. • **"on pins and needles"** means being in a state of anxiety or nervousness. (बेचैन या चिंतित होना) • **Example:** She was on pins and needles waiting for the job interview results. • **"in the seventh heaven"** means being extremely happy or in a state of bliss. (बेहद खुश होना) • **Example:** He was in the seventh heaven after hearing about his promotion. • **"bearing a grudge"** means holding a persistent feeling of resentment or ill will. (मन में बुराई रखना) • **Example:** Even after many years, he was still bearing a grudge against his former colleague. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'straight from the horse's mouth'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: __ • **on pins and needles **(चिंता में रहना): Being in a state of anxiety or nervousness. • **Example:** She was on pins and needles waiting for the doctor's call. • **in the seventh heaven **(सातवें आसमान पर): Being extremely happy. • **Example:** He was in the seventh heaven after winning the lottery. • **bearing a grudge** (रंजिश रखना): Holding a persistent feeling of resentment. • **Example:** She was still bearing a grudge against her friend for the old argument. 167:Tead, The correct answer is **Eknath Shinde**__.
